title: Single-atom catalyzed formation of inorganic-rich SEI/CEI for durable anode-free solid-state lithium metal batteries
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE05317J, Paper
Xiaosa Xu, Junjie Chen, Jin Li, Zhenyu Wang, Zixiao Guo, Pengzhu Lin, Yu Wang, Jing Sun, Baoling Huang, Tianshou Zhao
A single-Ni-atom-anchored COF as a catalyst is proposed to enhance the decomposition kinetics of lithium salt and construct the inorganic-rich SEI and CEI layers for anode-free solid-state lithium metal batteries.
